name: Clown Formula
description: Four ingredients and a method, copied in the Church clerk's hand. The Club sells these at cost and still makes a profit on what you must buy to fill them.

name: Clown Potion
description: Brewed to the formula by the Church's own dispensary. Drinking it is the easy part.

name: Magician Formula
description: The next rung, written out. Rozanne will not sign it out to a Sequence 9.

name: Magician Potion
description: Heavier than it looks, and colder than the room.

name: Faceless Formula
description: Three of its four ingredients are ordinary. The fourth is a name, freely given.

name: Faceless Potion
description: Rozanne hands it over without looking at you, which is not like her.

name: Telepathist Formula
description: Four ingredients and a method for opening a mind that is not yours, copied in the Church clerk's hand, with a marginal note advising against it.

name: Telepathist Potion
description: Brewed to the formula by the Church's own dispensary. It is quieter in the bottle than it will be in you.

name: Psychiatrist Formula
description: A method, a dosage, and three pages on what to do when the patient is you.

name: Psychiatrist Potion
description: Brewed by the Church. Smith recommends taking it somewhere you can be talked down from.

name: Hypnotist Formula
description: Blackthorn keeps this one in a locked drawer and the captain signs it out to himself before he signs it out to you.

name: Hypnotist Potion
description: Brewed by the Church, and handed over with a look.

name: Coffin Bearer Formula
description: Four ingredients and a method, in the Church clerk's hand, with the weights given in stones rather than ounces. He says that is deliberate.

name: Coffin Bearer Potion
description: Brewed to the formula by the Church's own dispensary. It is heavier than the bottle should be.

name: Gravekeeper Formula
description: A method that specifies the ground it must be brewed on, and is not joking.

name: Gravekeeper Potion
description: Brewed by the Church, on ground Old Neil declines to name.

name: Undertaker Formula
description: Written out on mourning stationery, which the captain insists is not a joke either.

name: Undertaker Potion
description: Brewed by the Church. It is exactly at room temperature and stays there.

name: Telepathist Formula (copied)
description: The same method in a stranger's hand, on paper that has been folded too many times. Cheaper. Counts for the rite, and the captain will know.
patter: 'Same words,' he says. 'Different penmanship. You're paying for the words.'

name: Coffin Bearer Formula (copied)
description: A trade method, copied by somebody in the trade, with one weight corrected in a second hand. Cheaper. Counts for the rite, and the captain will know.
patter: 'Undertaker's boy sold it me,' he says, which is either a provenance or a warning.

name: Warding Chalk
description: A stick of consecrated chalk. Draw the circle before you drink, every time, no matter how late it is. Carrying one halves the risk when you take the reckless route.

use.label: Check the circle
use.description: You draw a practice circle on the floorboards and walk it twice, correcting nothing, which is how you know you have it. Keep the chalk for the rite itself.

name: Copper Plumb and Thread
description: A diviner's weight on waxed thread, taken off Welch Tapman's floor. It is warm, it has not stopped pointing, and the Church has a number for it.

name: Welch’s Notebook
description: His own stitching and his own hand, with one leaf cut out close to the thread and two words surviving at the gutter.

name: Mourning Ring
description: Jet and braided hair, out of the estate and unclaimed. Blackthorn will take it off your hands and not ask which estate.

name: Sergeant’s Key
description: Gehrman's key to the sealed rooms off Narcissus Street, lent for the afternoon on the understanding that you were never given it.

name: Clown Formula (copied)
description: The same four ingredients in a stranger's hand, on paper that has been folded too many times. Cheaper. Counts for the rite, and the captain will know.
patter: 'Same words,' he says. 'Different penmanship. You're paying for the words.'

name: Doubtful Reagents
description: Enough to brew one potion, at about the purity the label does not claim. Whatever formula you are working from, these will fill it. Blackthorn would not sign for them.
patter: He does not tell you where they came from and you decide not to develop a theory.

use.label: Brew it yourself
use.description: You spend a night over a borrowed burner with the formula propped against the sugar tin. What comes out is the right colour and very slightly wrong, and it will do.

name: Forged Warrant
description: A constabulary warrant with a real seal and an invented name. Good for one door, and only if nobody reads past the seal.
patter: 'The seal's genuine,' he says, which is not the same as the warrant being genuine, and he knows you noticed.

use.label: Present it to the constable
use.description: Gehrman reads as far as the seal, which is the only part that is real, and hands over the key without finishing the sentence he had started.

name: Set of Picks
description: Steel, worn smooth. Carrying them is itself an offence, which is why they are sold in an alley.

name: Bottle of Laudanum
description: Steadies a spirit body that has been asked to do too much. Everybody in this city is on it and nobody discusses it.

use.label: Take a dose
use.description: Bitter, and it works. The shaking stops and the room stops leaning. You will pay for it tomorrow, but tomorrow is a separate problem.
